scenarios.name: Dock a floating panel to an edge with a visible target preview

scenario_steps.name: a part document is active in the MCAD Software
a dockable panel is floating over the workspace
the user drags the panel title bar toward the left workspace edge
the left docking target is indicated before the panel is released
the user releases the panel over that target
the panel docks along the left edge of the workspace
the viewport resizes to occupy the remaining workspace
the active part remains visible

scenarios.name: Dock a panel to each supported workspace edge

scenario_steps.name: a part document is active in the MCAD Software
a dockable panel is floating over the workspace
the user docks the panel to the right workspace edge
the panel is attached along the right edge
the viewport occupies the workspace to its left
the user docks the panel to the top workspace edge
the panel is attached below the ribbon
the viewport occupies the workspace below the panel
the user docks the panel to the bottom workspace edge
the panel is attached above the document tabs and status area
the viewport occupies the workspace above the panel

scenarios.name: Resize a docked panel from its shared boundary

scenario_steps.name: a part document is active in the MCAD Software
a dockable panel is docked beside the viewport
the user drags the panel boundary away from the viewport
the panel becomes wider
the viewport becomes narrower by the corresponding amount
the panel contents and active part remain visible
the user drags the boundary back
the panel and viewport return to their previous proportions

scenarios.name: Dock and resize Appearance Browser on the right

scenario_steps.name: a part document is active in the MCAD Software
Appearance Browser is floating over the workspace
the user drags the Appearance Browser title bar to the far right workspace edge
Appearance Browser docks along the right edge
the Model Browser remains visible on the left
the viewport occupies the space between both browser panels
the active part document remains open
the user drags the shared boundary toward the viewport to widen Appearance Browser
Appearance Browser becomes wider
the viewport becomes narrower
the view orientation control remains visible in the viewport
the user restores the boundary to its earlier position
the docked panel and viewport return to their earlier proportions

scenarios.name: Tab, switch, close, and restore docked browser panels

scenario_steps.name: a part document is active in the MCAD Software
Appearance Browser is docked on the right
Material Browser is floating over the workspace
the user drags the Material Browser title bar onto the Appearance Browser tab strip
both browsers occupy one right-side dock region as tabs
one browser is active while the other remains available
a single tab bar contains both browser tabs
the viewport remains visible to the left of the dock region
the user selects the Appearance Browser tab
Appearance Browser contents become visible in the dock region
the panel presents appearance choices without a second browser tab bar
the user selects the Material Browser tab
Material Browser contents become visible in the dock region
the panel presents material choices without a second browser tab bar
the user selects Appearance Browser and closes it from its panel controls
Appearance Browser is removed from the tab group
Material Browser remains visible in the right dock region
the user opens View and then User Interface
the user selects Appearance Browser
Appearance Browser returns as a tab in the right dock region
its contents are visible

scenarios.name: Open a workspace panel from the dock tab bar

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout/WorkspacePartBrowser.ipt` is open in the MCAD Software
Model is docked and Log is closed
the user clicks the plus button in the Model dock tab bar
the panel menu offers Log Panel, Favorites, Material Browser and Appearance Browser
the user chooses Log Panel from that menu
Log is available beside Model in the same dock tab bar
the user selects Log and closes its dock tab
Log is removed from the tab bar
Model is still available in the same dock region

scenarios.name: Join panels in one dock region as selectable tabs

scenario_steps.name: a part document is active in the MCAD Software
two dockable panels are open in separate workspace regions
the user drags one panel onto the center of the other panel's dock region
the destination region indicates a tab insertion target
the user releases the panel over that target
both panels occupy the same dock region as tabs
one panel is active while the other remains available
the user selects the other panel tab
its contents replace the active panel contents in that region
the viewport and active document remain available

scenarios.name: Float a docked panel and dock it again

scenario_steps.name: a part document is active in the MCAD Software
a dockable panel is docked beside the viewport
the user drags its title bar away from the dock targets
the panel floats above the workspace
the viewport expands into the space released by the panel
the user drags the floating panel to a workspace dock target
the panel docks at that target
the viewport adjusts to the resulting workspace layout

scenarios.name: Close a docked panel and restore it from the interface menu

scenario_steps.name: a part document is active in the MCAD Software
a dockable panel is the active tab in a dock region
the user closes the panel
the panel is removed from the visible workspace
the remaining dock regions and viewport use the freed space
the user opens the interface visibility menu
the user selects the closed panel
the panel is restored to the workspace
its contents are visible

scenarios.name: Retain a panel layout while switching active documents

scenario_steps.name: two documents are open in the MCAD Software
a dockable panel has been moved, resized, or tabbed in the workspace
the user switches to the other document
the docked panel arrangement remains in place
the active document changes in the viewport
the user returns to the first document
the panel arrangement remains available

scenarios.name: Restore the saved panel arrangement after restarting the application

scenario_steps.name: the user has changed the workspace panel arrangement
the MCAD Software has saved that arrangement
the user closes and restarts the MCAD Software
the saved panel positions, sizes and tab groups are restored
